title: Size bound for the 3-CNF encoding
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables. The number of 3-clauses in the 3-SAT encoding of the circuit’s Tseitin CNF is at most $13$ times the length of the encoding of the pair $(n,C)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit tree $C$ on $n$ variables
